brief:
Israeli authorities handed over the body of 17-year-old Walid Khaled Ahmad, a Palestinian detainee who died in March 2025 while imprisoned at Megiddo Prison, according to the Wafa news agency. Ahmad had been held for six months before his death.

The circumstances surrounding his death remain unclear from available reports. His case adds to a mounting list of Palestinian detainees who have died in Israeli custody.

title: Israel returns body of Palestinian teen who died in prison custody
